extracted.name: Blueberry Yogurt Cake
extracted.description: Enjoy a soft, moist, and delicious Blueberry Yogurt Cake made with simple ingredients and bursting with juicy blueberries. The yogurt gives this cake a light and tender texture, making it perfect for breakfast, tea time, or a quick homemade dessert. It’s easy to make, full of flavor, and loved by everyone Are you interested in my food? You can follow my YouTube channel and Instagram page. https://youtube.com/@amazingfoodiesca?si=XvMGDm01mHlyc_3L re https://www.instagram.com/amazing_foodies_?igsh=MTAyYnE0OWNsYnBiNA%3D%3D&utm_source=qr
ingredient_lines: 1 cup Fresh or frozen blueberries (150 g)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line an 8-inch cake pan.
Mix Wet Ingredients. In a bowl, whisk: eggs, sugar, yogurt, oil and vanilla until smooth and creamy.
Mix Dry Ingredients In another bowl, combine: flour, baking powder and salt.
Add dry ingredients into wet mixture. Mix gently until just combined (do not overmix).
Add Blueberries: Coat blueberries with 1 tbsp flour. Fold gently into the batter.
Pour batter into the pan. Bake for 35–40 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let it cool completely before slicing.
